title: Frontend: Sum of all numbers in an array
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Sum of all numbers in an array. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values). Return the sum of finite numbers; empty input returns zero. Reject any nonfinite or nonnumeric entry with Invalid number.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use a linear accumulator or reduce with an initial zero so empty input is defined.
alternativeApproaches: Implement compensated summation and compare it with integer-minor-unit arithmetic for money.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty array; negatives; mixed signs.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
